en: Tinted vintage view of Ljubljana/Laibach showing Marijin trg (Marienplatz): the Franciscan Church of the Annunciation dominates the right, the Prešeren Monument stands in the center, and the edge of the Triple Bridge and buildings around the square are visible. A short handwritten message appears on the front. The reverse reads "Dopisnica. Korrespondenz-Karte" and bears a green Austrian 5 heller Franz Joseph stamp; publisher credit is printed along the side.
